# Manufacturing Business Glossary

This glossary defines the core business concepts and terminology used in the manufacturing supply chain domain. It covers product structures, materials management, production workflows, and quality assurance processes.

## Product

A Product represents any manufactured item in the system, including finished goods ready for sale, sub-assemblies used in production, and individual components. Products are organized in a hierarchical structure where complex product... [TRUNCATED]

## Warehouse

A Warehouse represents a physical storage location where materials, components, and finished goods are stored. Warehouses have defined capacity limits, geographic location information, and are managed by designated managers. Warehouses serve as nodes in the supply chain network where inventory is held, shipments are received, and products are staged for production or distribution.

**Key Attributes:**
- Unique warehouse identifier
- Warehouse name and location
- Address, city, and ... [TRUNCATED]

## QualityControl

Quality Control (QC) represents inspection and testing activities performed on materials, in-process production, or finished goods. QC records track the type of inspection (incoming, in-process, final), inspection date, inspector, test results (pass, fail, conditional), defect counts, and notes. QC activities are associated with specific production batches and may reference technical specifications being tested.

tables_enriched.name: Product
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about products, including identifiers, names, categories, hierarchical relationships to parent products, cost, lead time, and active status for inventory and sales processing.

tables_enriched.name: component
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about individual components, including their identifiers, names, categories, measurement units, standard cost, and associated specification reference.

tables_enriched.name: Bill of Materials
tables_enriched.description: Stores the hierarchical composition of products, listing which components (with quantities and units) make up each parent product at a given BOM level, including whether a component is optional.

tables_enriched.name: supplier
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about suppliers, including contact details, quality rating, and whether the supplier is marked as preferred.

tables_enriched.name: warehouse
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about each warehouse, including its identifying details, location, capacity, and the manager responsible for the facility.

tables_enriched.name: Inventory
tables_enriched.description: Stores current inventory levels for each product and component by warehouse, including quantities on hand, quantities reserved, and the threshold to trigger a reorder, along with the date of the last ... [TRUNCATED]

tables_enriched.name: work_order
tables_enriched.description: Stores data about work orders including product referenced, hierarchy to parent work orders, quantities, status and priority, planned timing, and warehouse allocation.

tables_enriched.name: Shipment
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of shipments including identifiers, involved warehouse and supplier, related customer, shipping dates, and current status.

tables_enriched.name: quality_control
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of quality control checks performed on batches, including the type of check, who inspected it, the date, results, and any defects counted along with notes.

tables_enriched.name: Specification
tables_enriched.description: Stores specifications for products or processes, including identification, versioning, applicable date, type, critical parameters, acceptable value ranges, and measurement units.

tables_enriched.name: Batch
tables_enriched.description: Stores records of product batches, including the production date, quantity produced, warehouse location, expiry date, and current quality control status.

tables_enriched.name: route
tables_enriched.description: Stores the routing steps for products, detailing the sequence of operations, associated work centers, and the cycle and setup times required for each route.

tables_enriched.name: Component Supplier
tables_enriched.description: Stores the relationship between components and suppliers, including whether a supplier is preferred, typical lead time for orders, and current unit pricing.
